LanguageData.CC_Impact_GamblerTurns: A cheat caught at the table could start a fistfight with a hot-tempered loser
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Challenge_Tribal: A runner of {FACTION} came to the gate and would not leave until {PAWN_nameDef} had heard the words of {NOTABLE} by heart: an insult is not forgotten among their people, and a champion is coming to settle it by their ways. {PAWN_nameDef} may meet them, or turn them away and be thought the less of for it.\n\nA letter of greetings to their people, or a good word or a gift for one of them before the champion comes, would settle it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Challenge_Medieval: A sealed letter from {NOTABLE} of {FACTION} for {PAWN_nameDef}: a challenge, in a fine hand, to answer for what passed between them by the ways of their people, with a champion who will come to the colony's gate to settle it. {PAWN_nameDef} may meet them, or refuse and be thought the less of for it.\n\nA letter of greetings to their people, or a good word or a gift for one of them before the champion comes, would settle it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Challenge_Industrial: A demand came over the radio from {NOTABLE} of {FACTION}, read out twice for {PAWN_nameDef}: what passed between them is to be settled in person, and someone is on the way to the colony to do it. {PAWN_nameDef} may meet them, or refuse and be thought the less of for it.\n\nA letter of greetings to their people, or a good word or a gift for one of them before they come, would settle it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Challenge_Spacer: A message on the comms from {NOTABLE} of {FACTION}, addressed to {PAWN_nameDef} by name: a formal challenge over what passed between them, and a champion of theirs is coming to the colony to answer it. {PAWN_nameDef} may meet them, or refuse and be thought the less of for it.\n\nA letter of greetings to their people, or a good word or a gift for one of them before the champion comes, would settle it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Mote_StepsFall: a fall on the new leg
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Mote_Lost_ankle: a turned ankle in the dark
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_Mote_Lost_scrape: a scraped knee in the dark
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_SetUpon: {PAWN_nameDef}, a messenger of {FACTION}, was set upon by bandits of {BANDITS} at the edge of the colony's land, cut, and is coming on to the gate. The bandits are running for it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmSeven_SetUponScared: Bandits of {BANDITS} went for {PAWN_nameDef}, a messenger of {FACTION}, at the edge of the colony's land, and ran when they saw the colony's people near.
